AC-1_vc-approved.location: docs/agents/qa/flow/main.md, <!-- jump:vc-approved --> block (currently prose-only, ends '...IN THE SAME orch-apply.sh write').
AC-1_vc-approved.instruction: Insert an executable jq+orch-apply.sh block immediately after the existing prose sentence (keep the prose — it explains intent; add the pipe as the literal mechanism), following the file's own WF-1 STOP-RELEASE style (line 30-33: --arg flags, .head-shape jq filter, $PROJECT_ROOT).
AC-1_vc-approved.code:
NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
jq --arg id "$task_id" --arg now "$NOW" --arg note "$REVIEW_RECORD_NOTE" '
  (.task_board.qa // []) as $q
  | ([$q[] | select(.id == $id)][0]) as $t
  | if $t == null then error("id not in qa[] -- refuse")
    elif ($t.status // null) != "QA" then error("status != QA (\($t.status)) -- refuse")
    else . end
  | .task_board.qa = [$q[] | select(.id != $id)]
  | .task_board.done_verified = ((.task_board.done_verified // []) + [
      ($t + {
        status: "DONE_VERIFIED",
        next_agent: null,
        qa_verified_at: $now,
        status_note: (($t.status_note // "") + "\n[QA] Review Record (direct-commit verify): " + $note)
      })
    ])
' "$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/data/orch/orch-state.json" | bash "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/orch-apply.sh"
AC-1_vc-approved.ac3_self_verify: jq -e --arg id "$task_id" '.task_board.done_verified[] | select(.id == $id) | .status == "DONE_VERIFIED"' "$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/data/orch/orch-state.json" || { echo "LANE-MOVE NOT PERSISTED"; exit 1; }  # RETURN may not assert the lane-move without this passing

AC-2_vc-changes.location: docs/agents/qa/flow/main.md, <!-- jump:vc-changes --> block (currently 100% prose, zero orch-apply mention).
AC-2_vc-changes.instruction: Same pattern, target lane review[], flip status QA->REVIEW, stamp redispatch_count+=1, route next_agent/owner to the row's OWN .owner field per the existing prose ('NOT fixer -- there is no task branch for a fixer to work on').
AC-2_vc-changes.code:
NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
jq --arg id "$task_id" --arg now "$NOW" --arg note "$ISSUE_NOTE" '
  (.task_board.qa // []) as $q
  | ([$q[] | select(.id == $id)][0]) as $t
  | if $t == null then error("id not in qa[] -- refuse")
    elif ($t.status // null) != "QA" then error("status != QA (\($t.status)) -- refuse")
    else . end
  | .task_board.qa = [$q[] | select(.id != $id)]
  | .task_board.review = ((.task_board.review // []) + [
      ($t + {
        status: "REVIEW",
        next_agent: $t.owner,
        redispatch_count: (($t.redispatch_count // 0) + 1),
        status_note: (($t.status_note // "") + "\n[QA] CHANGES_REQUESTED (direct-commit verify): " + $note)
      })
    ])
' "$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/data/orch/orch-state.json" | bash "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/orch-apply.sh"
AC-2_vc-changes.ac3_self_verify: jq -e --arg id "$task_id" '.task_board.review[] | select(.id == $id) | .status == "REVIEW"' "$PROJECT_ROOT/docs/data/orch/orch-state.json" || { echo "LANE-MOVE NOT PERSISTED"; exit 1; }
